newsitem.title: USA: EDS SEES 1997 EPS AT $1.90 TO $2.00.
newsitem.headline: EDS SEES 1997 EPS AT $1.90 TO $2.00.

text.p: EDS said on Thursday that it expected an erosion of revenues and earnings to deflate 1997 financial performances to a range of $1.90 to $2.00 per share.
Earlier, the information services provider said it expected to post 1997 earnings of $2.30 to $2.35 per share before any charge.
The projection follows the introduction of a restructuring plan that eliminates a number of positions at EDS and streamlined various business units.
EDS said the initiative, which will extend into next year, is expected to produce savings this year of more than $250 million.

"To date, nearly 8,500 positions have been identified for elimination under the initiative, resulting in approximately 3,000 employees who have either left or will leave the company," EDS said in a statement.
